expectations.rationale: The installed coordinator is independently inspectable through the generic module inspection route; exact coordinator operation identities remain a separate adoption gate.
The independently installed coordinator requires a deterministic qxctl package and contract validation route.
Authenticated authority epochs require explicit begin, checkpoint or transition, and close administration.
Current authority-epoch state must remain independently queryable.
Interrupted authority-epoch mutation requires explicit bounded recovery.
Lifecycle convergence requires one explicit permission-backed qxctl apply route.
Prepared and finalized lifecycle apply state must be observable without mutation.
Interrupted apply coordination requires an explicit evidence-preserving recovery route.
Planning begins from an explicit bounded observation of installed and configured state.
Boot planning preserves one explicit durable report-only lifecycle entry point.
The plan and its durable boot state require separate read-only report and status routes.
Repository reconciliation requires explicit begin, checkpoint, and close transitions.
Compatibility and current reconciliation state must remain independently queryable.
Interrupted reconciliation requires explicit forward recovery.
Semantic baseline maintenance requires explicit begin, checkpoint, and close transitions.
Semantic-maintenance lineage must remain independently queryable.
Interrupted semantic maintenance requires explicit digest-linked recovery.
The authority-free C++ foundation is statically linked and has no independently executable administration surface.
Bounded request, response, deadline, and error mechanics execute only inside a consuming process.
Snapshot and digest primitives are library behavior exercised through the consuming engine operation.
Temporal conformance is enforced at library and consuming-operation boundaries rather than administered as a standalone process.
Exact receptor presence is directly inspectable through qxctl.
Docking and undocking are delegated to the separately authorized lifecycle apply circuit.
Current receptor status is directly queryable through qxctl.
Interrupted presence mutation requires explicit forward recovery.
Complete sorted receptor inventory is a direct read-only qxctl query.
The platform umbrella is discoverable through complete component inventory and module enumeration.
